name: shoptet.product.code neodpovídá dokumentaci
description:
V dokumentaci [dataLayeru](https://developers.shoptet.com/shoptet-tools/data-layer/) není uvedeno `shoptet.product.code`, ale u produktů bez variant v datech je.

```java
dataLayer[0].shoptet.product.hasVariants ==> true
dataLayer[0].shoptet.product.codes[0].code ==> 326
dataLayer[0].shoptet.product.code ==> undefined
```

```java
dataLayer[0].shoptet.product.hasVariants ==> false
dataLayer[0].shoptet.product.codes[0].code ==> 345
dataLayer[0].shoptet.product.code ==> "345"
```
